description: A thematic map illustrating a mixed rural landscape featuring different land cover and land use types. The map shows a central area designated as "Rural settlement," represented by a white background containing multiple black and grey rectangular shapes. Surrounding this settlement is a mosaic of agricultural land. "Grassland" is depicted by solid light green areas. "Orchards" are shown as light green areas with dark green circular features. "Arable land" is represented by light yellow areas with fine vertical stripes. "Roads" are indicated by light green strips containing a central vertical white stripe, extending through the landscape and connecting to the settlement. One small isolated black rectangular feature, possibly an outlying building, is also visible adjacent to a road segment and an orchard. This map visually represents the concept of "Complex cultivation patterns" (as described in CLC+ class 2.3.2), highlighting the mixture of annual crops (arable land), pastures (grassland), and permanent crops (orchards) along with settlements and infrastructure. No scale bar, compass, or reference year is provided.
